description: Explains how code really works, with file:line evidence: architecture, the end-to-end execution path, where state lives, how it fails, and what a PR changes. Use when the user asks how a repo, module, or function works, wants a request or operation traced through code, is onboarding onto unfamiliar code, asks what a PR or diff really does, wants to understand concurrency or failure behavior, or types /underhood, even if they never say "architecture". Not for writing or fixing code, and not for style or lint feedback.
